EX-99.1 2 a2026-10x19aquestivepduf.htm EX-99.1 a2026-10x19aquestivepduf Aquestive Therapeutics Announces FDA Acceptance of Anaphylm™ NDA Resubmission and PDUFA Goal Date of March 16, 2027 • FDA accepted the resubmission as complete and classified it as a Class 2 response • Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) goal action date set for March 16, 2027 • Ex-U.S. strategy remains on track with Canadian NDS planned for Q4 2026 WARREN, N.J., October 15, 2026 – Aquestive Therapeutics, Inc.

Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has acknowledged its resubmission of the New Drug Application (NDA) for Anaphylm™ (dibutepinephrine) sublingual film for the treatment of Type I allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis, as complete and has assigned a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) goal date of March 16, 2027, in keeping with the FDA’s classification of the resubmission as a Class 2 response.

Aquestive submitted the resubmission to the Anaphylm NDA on September 16, 2026, following the August 2026 announcement of positive topline results from human factors and pharmacokinetic (PK) studies conducted to address the items raised in the FDA’s January 30, 2026, Complete Response Letter.

“The FDA’s acceptance of our resubmission and the assignment of a Class 2 PDUFA date as expected gives us a clear path forward for Anaphylm,” said Daniel Barber, President and Chief Executive Officer of Aquestive Therapeutics.
